hardware.measurement: Unmeasured planning target; C28 must verify or reduce it.

providers: optional local OPA and Syft/Grype report ingestion
full_engine_platform_target: Linux x86_64; other platforms need their own installed evidence
versions: Exact artifact/source/grammar versions, hashes, licenses and source-build routes are in docs/engineering/toolchain-lock.json. Go is required to build the C03 engine; OPA and Syft/Grype remain optional.
privileges: Ordinary local user; no root, Docker daemon, cloud credentials or provider account is required. Tools execute locally only when explicitly selected.
